description: The agent must: (1) Read db_config.json to find the db_path '/workspace/lab_memory/lancedb' and instantiate LanceMemoryDB from memory_skill.py at that exact path. (2) Parse research_notes.json and call add_memory() for each of the 15 notes, mapping 'text'->'content', 'topic'->'category', 'labels'->'tags', 'priority'->'importance'; the method assigns sequential integer IDs starting at 1. (3) Parse corrections_manifest.csv and call update_memory() for each row, using the note_id-to-DB-id mapping tracked during ingestion — specifically: update id=6 importance=10, update id=9 category='literature_review', update id=11 metadata={'verified':true,'data_team_contact':'priya.nair@lab.org'}, update id=15 tags=[...,'distillation_benchmark'], update id=2 importance=6. The PROPRIETARY TRAP is that update_memory() only accepts the valid_fields list and ignores ID/timestamp. (4) Read pruning_policy.json, query all memories, identify those with importance < 4 (after corrections): IDs 4,7,10,13 with importances 3,2,1,1 respectively, call delete_memory() on each, and collect the IDs. (5) Call get_memory_stats() to get the canonical stats dict with keys total_memories=11, categories=5, by_category={...}, date_range={...}. (6) Write memory_report.json with {'stats': <get_memory_stats() output>, 'deleted_ids': [4,7,10,13]}.
